newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P rates Normandy Mining BBB-minus.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P rates Normandy Mining BBB-minus.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Wednesday that it assigned a BBB-minus corporate credit rating to Normandy Mining Ltd, Australia's largest gold mining group.

S&P said the rating reflects Normandy's diverse portfolio of mine operations with the potential for further low-cost reserve replacement from existing mines and offshore exploration, and a satisfactory financial position.
"The new Normandy group has increased access to cash flow and an enhanced business position.

"However, Normandy's credit quality remains dependent on the company achieving the anticipated gains from its current projects, which are aimed at increasing operating efficiency and reserves." -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
